property_summary: For every caller address, calling the owner-only entrypoint owned() does not allow a non-owner to subsequently change owner via transferOwnership (only the account equal to c.owner() can transferOwnership); the mutant that removes the onlyOwner require allows a non-owner caller to invoke owned() and then call transferOwnership to change owner, violating this invariant for some fuzzed caller/newOwner inputs.
change_summary: Weaken the ownership check by allowing any caller (remove the require condition) so onlyOwner no longer reverts based on msg.sender.
